{{nihongo|'''Murakuni Shrine'''|村国神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

'''Murakuni Shrine''' (むらくにじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Kakamigahara|Q641491|qid=Q641491}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}. It is a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=shikinaisha}}. It is regarded as the tutelary shrine of the Kakami area ({{ill|Kakami|ja|各務村|qid=Q11412364|lt=Kakami district}}) in Kakamigahara City. It is one of the five {{ill|Kinpei-sha|Q119929592|qid=Q119929592}} in Kakamigahara.

According to the Engishiki Jinmyōchō, there are two seats of Murakuni Shrine in {{ill|Kakami district|Q11412369|qid=Q11412369}}, {{ill|Mino Province|ckb|پارێزگای مینۆ|cs|Mino (provincie)|de|Provinz Mino|es|Provincia de Mino|eu|Mino probintzia|fa|ولایت مینو|fr|Province de Mino|gl|Provincia de Mino|hak|Mî-nùng-koet|id|Provinsi Mino|it|Mino (provincia)|ja|美濃国|ko|미노국|lt|Mino žemė|nl|Mino (provincie)|pt|Província de Mino|ru|Мино (провинция)|simple|Mino Province|sk|Mino (provincia)|sr|Провинција Мино|th|แคว้นมิโนะ|tr|Mino (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Міно|vi|Tỉnh Mino|wuu|美濃国|zh|美濃國|zh_min_nan|Mino-kok|zh_yue|美濃國|qid=Q864156}} (now Kakamigahara). There are two Murakuni Shrines in Kakami Ogase-chō 3-chōme, and the other Murakuni Shrine (3-85) is only about 150 meters away in a straight line (about 50 meters from the approach entrance). The shrine at 85 is said to be the site of the grave of {{ill|Murakuni Oyori|fa|ماروکونی اویوری|ja|村国男依|qid=Q6937264}}, and is now an {{ill|Otabisho|es|Otabisho|fr|Otabisho|ja|御旅所|qid=Q11489117}}. In the precinct next to the haiden stands the playhouse {{ill|Murakuni-za|ja|村国座|qid=Q11523051}} ('''Kakami no Butai'''), designated as an {{ill|National Important Tangible Folk Cultural Property|ja|重要有形民俗文化財|qid=Q11644858}}<ref name="murakuniza">{{Cite web|和書|date= |url=http://www.pref.gifu.lg.jp/kyoiku-bunka-sports/bunka-geijutsu/bunkazai-zuroku/yuumin/kakami.html |title=Kakami no Butai |publisher=Gifu Prefecture |accessdate=2015-06-06}}</ref>.

=== Outline ===
It is one of the five Kinpeisha in Kakamigahara City.

It is said to have been founded in the {{ill|Asuka period|ar|فترة أسوكا|be|Перыяд Асука|bg|Асука|bn|আসুকা যুগ|ca|Període Asuka|cs|Období Asuka|de|Asuka-Zeit|eo|Asuka-epoko|es|Período Asuka|eu|Asuka aroa|fa|دوره آسوکا|fi|Asuka-kausi|fr|Période d'Asuka|he|תקופת אסוקה|hr|Asuka (razdoblje)|hu|Aszuka-kor|id|Zaman Asuka|it|Periodo Asuka|ja|飛鳥時代|ko|아스카 시대|lt|Asuka laikotarpis|ms|Zaman Asuka|nl|Asukaperiode|nn|Asuka|no|Asuka|pl|Asuka (okres)|pt|Período Asuka|ru|Период Асука|sh|Asuka period|simple|Asuka period|sk|Obdobie Asuka|sl|Obdobje Asuka|sq|Periudha Asuka|sr|Асука период|sv|Asuka|th|ยุคอาซูกะ|tl|Panahong Asuka|tr|Asuka Dönemi|uk|Період Асука|vi|Thời kỳ Asuka|zh|飛鳥時代|zh_classical|飛鳥時代|zh_min_nan|Asuka sî-tāi|zh_yue|飛鳥時代|qid=Q210688}} by the {{ill|Murakuni Clan|ja|村国氏|qid=Q11523054}} with {{ill|Amenohoakari|fr|Ame-no-hoakari|it|Amenohoakari|ja|天火明命|ko|아메노호아카리|mni|ꯑꯃꯦꯅꯣꯍꯣꯑꯀꯔꯤ|simple|Ame-no-hoakari|zh|天火明命|qid=Q10940411}} and {{ill|Ishikori-dome no Mikoto|it|Ishikori-dome no Mikoto|ja|イシコリドメ|ru|Исикори-домэ но микото|zh|伊斯許理度賣命|qid=Q6080112|lt=Miko Ishikoridome-no-Uba-no-Mikoto}} as deities. Later, {{ill|Murakuni no Shigamaro|Q11523052|qid=Q11523052}} jointly enshrined {{ill|Murakuni Oyori|fa|ماروکونی اویوری|ja|村国男依|qid=Q6937264}}. Around {{ill|900|ab|900|af|900|als|900|am|900 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|900|ar|900|ary|900|arz|900|ast|900|avk|900|az|900|azb|۹۰۰ (میلادی)|ban|900|bar|900|bcl|900|be|900|be_x_old|900|bg|900|bn|৯০০|bpy|মারি ৯০০|br|900|bs|900.|ca|900|cdo|900 nièng|ceb|900|ckb|٩٠٠|crh|900|cs|900|csb|900|cv|900|cy|900|da|900|de|900|el|900|eml|900|eo|900|es|900|et|900|eu|900|fa|۹۰۰ (میلادی)|fi|900|fo|900|fr|900|frr|900|fy|900|ga|900|gan|900年|gd|900|gl|900|he|900|hi|९००|hr|900.|ht|900 (almanak jilyen)|hu|900|hy|900|id|900|ilo|900|io|900|is|900|it|900|ja|900年|jv|900|ka|900|kaa|900|kk|900 жыл|ko|900년|la|900|lb|900|lij|900|lmo|900|lt|900 m.|lv|900. gads|map_bms|900|mdf|900|mg|900|mhr|900|mi|900|mk|900|mr|इ.स. ९००|mrj|900 и|ms|900|mzn|۹۰۰|nah|900|nap|900|nds|900|new|सन् ९००|nl|900|nn|900|no|900|nrm|900|nso|900|oc|900|or|୯୦୦|os|900-æм аз|pl|900|pnb|900|pt|900|qu|900|ro|900|ru|900 год|rue|900|sa|९००|scn|900|sd|900ع|se|900|sh|900.|shn|900|si|900|simple|900|sk|900|sl|900|smn|900|sq|900|sr|900|su|900|sv|900|sw|900|ta|900|tg|Соли 900|th|พ.ศ. 1443|tk|900|tly|900|tr|900|tt|900 ел|uk|900|ur|900ء|uz|900|vec|900|vi|900|vls|900|war|900|wuu|900年|xmf|900|zea|900|zh|900年|zh_min_nan|900 nî|zh_yue|900年|qid=Q23460}} ({{ill|Jōhō|Q1193592|qid=Q1193592}} 3), Hakusan Gongen was jointly enshrined.

In {{ill|1877|Q7773|qid=Q7773}} ({{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 10), {{ill|Murakuni-za|ja|村国座|qid=Q11523051}} was completed as the venue for the shrine's dedicated plays ({{ill|Kabuki|Q199701|qid=Q199701}}), and in {{ill|1882|Q7812|qid=Q7812}} (Meiji 15) its opening performance (kokerawotoshi) was held.

On September 25, {{ill|1973|Q2477|qid=Q2477}} (Shōwa 48), it was designated by the Gifu Prefectural Shrine Association as a prefectural head-attendance designated shrine ({{ill|Kinpei-sha|Q119929592|qid=Q119929592}}), designation Kin No. 72{{sfn|Kimura|1997|p=77}}.

=== Precinct shrine ===
* Akiba Shrine

=== Annual festival ===
Every year on the second Saturday and Sunday of October, dedicated kabuki is performed as the annual festival of Murakuni Shrine. It is {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=jikai kabuki}} centered on children.
